createdFor: Phase 5 evacuation building qualification rulebook planning
evidencePriority: official evacuation shelter / disaster facility data
official hazard/disaster maps and administrative disaster documents
OSM / routing data as auxiliary evidence

confidenceLevels.meaning: Evidence and spatial matching are strong enough for automated use with low residual uncertainty.
Evidence is plausible but has match, metadata, or source limitations that should be visible to reviewers.
Evidence is weak, incomplete, conflicting, or based mainly on candidate inference.
Evidence is unavailable or insufficient to assign confidence.

plannedRuleGroups.purpose: Determine whether official source evidence confirms the building or requires review.
Plan point-in-footprint, nearest-building, multi-candidate, and match-distance review rules.
Plan safe floor, building height, and vertical evacuation candidate criteria.
Plan hazard-map context, inundation-depth warnings, and scenario applicability checks.
Plan estimated route distance, travel time, and routing warning fields.
Plan capacity, crowding, and missing-capacity review rules.
Plan conflict handling, missing field warnings, stale source checks, and manual review triggers.

manualReviewTriggers: shelter point not inside building footprint
nonClaims: candidate buildings are not official unless official evidence confirms them
routing results are estimated prototype routes
hazard context does not equal flood simulation
